description: Get full vehicle, subscription, mileage, fees and availability details of one offer, by the provider and id that search_offers returns. source_url redirects to the provider.

id.description: The id field of an offer from search_offers. Send the provider_id of the same offer as provider: the id identifies an offer only together with its provider.

provider.description: The provider of the offer, by the provider_id that offers show, such as finn. /agent-instructions.md lists the providers that have offers now.

name: get_offer

checked_at.description: When abomio.de last checked the catalogue.

offer.description: The offer with its vehicle, monthly rate, term, mileage, costs, equipment, energy data and availability. Unknown values are left out.

availability.description: available: confirmed by the provider. stale: still listed, but not confirmed for 45 minutes. unavailable: no longer offered; since is when it left.

body_type.description: Body style of the car. kleinwagen is a small car, kompaktwagen a compact hatchback, limousine a saloon, kombi an estate, suv an SUV or SUV coupé, coupe a coupé or sports car, cabrio a convertible, van a people carrier or minibus and transporter a panel van or pick-up. Absent when abomio.de has not classified the model yet.

changed_at.description: When the offer last changed, as listed in changes.

changes.description: Why the offer last changed at changed_at: new (first found), returned (offered again after it left) or price (monthly rate went from previous to current).

co2_class.description: CO₂ class from A (lowest emissions) to G.

cost_coverage.description: status complete: all required provider costs are recorded in costs. partial or absent: more costs can apply. source_url leads to the page the costs come from.

costs.description: Recorded provider charges in euros, VAT included. A deposit is refundable and not a cost. A conditional charge applies only in some cases. A missing amount_eur is unknown, not zero. source_url leads to the page that states the charge.

customer_groups.description: Who can sign the contract: private persons, business customers or both.

delivery_note.description: German note on pickup, delivery or price conditions. Can be empty.

delivery_time.description: Delivery time in German, as abomio.de normalizes it.

drive_type.description: Driven axle: Allrad (all-wheel), Frontantrieb (front), Heckantrieb (rear) or Zweiradantrieb (two-wheel, axle unknown).

drive_type_conflict.description: true when the provider data names different drives; confirm the drive with the provider. Absent when there is no conflict.

eligibility_note.description: Provider conditions on who can subscribe.

equipment.description: Equipment the provider states: true when the car has it, false when not. A missing field is unknown.

excess_km_rate_eur.description: Price in euros for each kilometre above the included mileage. Absent when unknown.

first_seen_at.description: When abomio.de first found the offer.

fuel_type.description: Engine type: elektro (battery electric), benzin (petrol), diesel, hybrid (not plug-in), plug_in_hybrid, verbrenner (combustion engine, fuel not stated) or unbekannt (not stated). mild_hybrid is an old value; mild hybrids are listed by the fuel they burn.

guaranteed_model.description: true: the provider supplies this model. false: the provider may supply a similar model.

id.description: Offer ID, unique within its provider. Use it with provider_id to read the full offer.

image_url.description: Full URL of the vehicle photo on abomio.de, or an empty string.

max_excess_km.description: Most extra kilometres the provider allows above the included mileage.

power_provenance.description: For ps and kw: reported by the provider, or converted from the other unit by abomio.de. conflict is true when the provider values disagree, and absent when they agree.

price_per_month_eur.description: Monthly rate in euros, VAT included.

provider_host.description: Host of the provider page that source_url leads to, such as www.finn.com.

provider_id.description: The provider of the offer, by the provider_id that offers show, such as finn. /agent-instructions.md lists the providers that have offers now.

scraped_at.description: When abomio.de last read this offer from the provider.

source_url.description: Link to the offer on abomio.de. It counts the click and redirects to the provider's page, or to the model page when the offer is no longer available. Programs that open a link to FINN or SIXT also get the model page.

trailer_hitch.description: Whether the car has a trailer hitch. Absent when unknown.

transmission.description: Gearbox: automatik (automatic), manuell (manual) or unbekannt (not stated).

vehicle.description: Vehicle names as abomio.de normalizes them. title is the full display name.

path.description: Path of the model's comparison page on abomio.de, below /gewerbe for business-only offers. Absent when the model has no page.

vehicle_energy.description: Consumption and emissions as the provider reports them; standard and basis tell how they were measured. For plug-in hybrids, combined holds the unweighted combined values and depleted_battery the values with an empty battery. reported_consumption has no confirmed distance unit. source_url leads to the page that states them.

vehicle_range.description: Electric range in km, from min_km to max_km. basis maximum means an upper limit. scope category means the value is for a vehicle class, not this car.

published_at.description: When the published offers last changed.

title: Get offer details
